source_statement: Every finite real m by n matrix A admits R:m by min(m,n) and Q:min(m,n) by n with A=RQ and QQ^T=I, including dependent/zero rows and empty dimensions. Wide subcase m<=n; additive commutative monoid prefix-sum prerequisite stated separately. No triangularity, unique factors, executable procedure, resource, quantum success or approximation theorem.
